subtitle: You can complete the basic onboarding first. Platform and Codex model setup can both be skipped.

onboard.title: Quick Onboarding
onboard.subtitle: Complete initialization directly on the welcome page.
onboard.step1Desc: The agent runs on Codex, and its model is set only on the Codex page: sign in with a ChatGPT account or an OpenAI API key, or add a custom model provider, then choose a model.
onboard.step2Desc: Connect AstrBot to IM platforms like QQ, Lark, Slack, Telegram, etc.
onboard.step3Title: Allow Agent to Use the Computer
onboard.step3Desc: Set whether the Agent may use a computer environment. It only runs inside a third-party sandbox, never on this computer.
onboard.step3HelpItem1: With the sandbox option, the Agent runs shell commands, Python code and file operations only inside a third-party sandbox (Shipyard Neo, Shipyard, CUA or BoxLite), never on this computer.
onboard.step3HelpItem2: By default, sandbox capabilities are available only to AstrBot administrators.
onboard.step3Sandbox: Sandbox only (Shipyard or another third-party sandbox)
onboard.computerAccessUpdateFailed: Failed to update Agent computer access
onboard.computerAccessAllowed: Agent is now allowed to access and use the computer
onboard.computerAccessDenied: Agent is no longer allowed to access and use the computer
onboard.step3HelpItem3: For more detailed control, configure the Computer Access options under Config -> AI -> Capabilities -> Agent Computer Use.
